from_quote: On bills relieving "from disability under the fourteenth amendment
rationale: The Speaker names bills relieving "from disability under the fourteenth amendment" by a two-thirds vote; only Section 3 of the Fourteenth Amendment fits.

from_quote: The only imperative requirement of the yeas and nays under the Constitution is in regard to a veto, where a concurrent vote of two thirds of each House by yeas and nays is required.
rationale: The Speaker names the requirement of the Constitution that the vote of each House on a vetoed bill be taken by yeas and nays; only Article I, Section 7, Clause 2 fits.

from_quote: On all other questions requiring a two thirds vote, such as proposed amendments to the Constitution
rationale: The Speaker names proposed amendments to the Constitution among the questions "requiring a two thirds vote"; only Article V fits.
